## What changed?

Describe the problem and the solution. Link related issues with `Closes #...`
when applicable.

## How was it tested?

List the commands, test cases, and environments used.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one concern.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I ran `bun run check`.
- [ ] I ran `bun run audit`.
- [ ] I ran `bun run build`.
- [ ] I ran `bun run docker:config`.
- [ ] I ran `bun run test:e2e` when the change affects an application or shared
      UI.
- [ ] I tested the production containers when changing Docker or runtime
      configuration.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, personal data, local environment files, or
      generated artifacts.
- [ ] I included screenshots or recordings for visual changes.
